issues.detail: The Hebrew 'אֲרַוְנָה הַמֶּלֶךְ' means 'Araunah the king' (Araunah is the king), but the Vietnamese 'A-ra-un-na dâng tất cả những điều đó cho vua như một vị vua' renders it as 'Araunah gave all these things to the king as a king,' incorrectly making Araunah give to another king rather than being the king himself. This changes who is doing what to whom.
